terminal.purpose: Terminal content, Arabic presentation forms, Latin commands, and box drawing.

chrome.purpose: Compact status, shortcuts, and recovery controls.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Connection, focus, and inline recovery state transitions.

components.name: Active Direction Chip
components.description: Communicates active Arabic and English direction support.
components.css: .ds-direction-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; background:#20262d; color:#7dd3fc; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 8px; font:600 12px/1 'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; } .ds-direction-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Shortcut Keycap
components.description: Shows a terminal keyboard shortcut without becoming a button.
components.css: .ds-keycap { background:#20262d; color:#d3d9df; border:1px solid #39424c; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 5px; font:500 11px/1 'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; }

components.name: Retry Terminal
components.description: Restarts a failed PTY session from the inline recovery notice.
components.css: .ds-retry { background:#38bdf8; color:#07131a; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:7px 11px; font:600 12px/1 'Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-retry:hover { background:#7dd3fc; } .ds-retry:active { background:#0ea5e9; } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d3d9df; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Twitty is a terminal-first product. Calm, dense application chrome clarifies state and recovery while the terminal remains the dominant surface.

rules.name: The Disappearing Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome becomes prominent only for state, recovery, or settings.

rules.name: The Cell Integrity Rule
rules.body: Terminal typography changes require rendering regression tests.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: The terminal and status chrome never use decorative shadows.

dos: Do validate mixed-direction behavior in real workflows.
donts: Don't build a flashy or gamified AI terminal.
Don't apply full-page RTL to the terminal grid.
